calibration_anchor.closest_anchor: First-mover novelty in a growing fintech category, but unverified single-source claims
calibration_anchor.why_not_higher: The claim to be 'first in-chat brokerage' is novelty, but 40K beta users and volume are unverified and unaudited. No named brokerage partner. Single-source claim caps at 5 per rubric.
calibration_anchor.why_not_lower: The first-mover angle and novel product category are real; not floored

beat_relevance.rationale: Fintech beat plausibly covers in-app trading innovation

timeliness.rationale: Launch hook exists but no external catalyst or news moment

magnitude.rationale: 40K beta users is claimed but unverified; if real, noteworthy adoption

proof_points.rationale: Beta user count and 'meaningful volume' claimed but unaudited; no named brokerage partner to verify regulatory standing

narrative_quality.rationale: First-mover angle is credible; in-chat trading is novel enough to interest fintech reporters

source_credibility.rationale: Unknown startup; credibility depends on verifying the 40K claim and regulatory partnership

improvement_suggestions: Name the brokerage partner or publish the regulatory filing that authorizes in-app trading
Provide an audited or third-party-verified user count and trade-volume figure
Share a specific named customer case study or use case
evidence_gaps: Verified brokerage partner identity and licensing
Audited user count or third-party verification of 40K
Named customer or trade-volume metric with supporting data
dimensions.honest_assessment: The first-mover claim is credible and interesting, but unverified. A 40K-user startup without a named brokerage partner or audited numbers cannot anchor a pitch yet. Once verified, this becomes a 6-7 story.

next_move.rationale: Verify the brokerage partnership and user claims before outreach
